response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, exposure to agentic workflows via MCP tooling, and a track record of building event-driven systems, but lacks demonstrable production experience in fintech infrastructure, multi-agent AI at scale, or leadership of 10+ person engineering teams — key requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks and MCP tooling in production
Proven ability to build event-driven, distributed systems (GISCollective, real-time data apps)
Strong engineering culture advocacy (TDD, CI/CD, code kata leadership)
concerns: No evidence of leading engineering teams beyond 5–10 people or developing senior technical leadership layers
No demonstrated experience in fintech, credit risk, or regulated financial systems
Lacks clear track record in real-time inference, LLM evaluation pipelines, or AI-system reliability under financial SLAs
